page.overview:
Who is Mirlene Cornwell?

Mirlene is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

She was enrolled in the Novice book in at the age of sixteen. After spending eleven years as a Novice and seven as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in at the age of 34.

Mirlene was in the group of Aes Sedai that kidnapped Rand. She and both her Warders were killed during the Battle at Dumai's Wells.

Mirlene Cornwell is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion". She is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
